text: The Android master writes this wall in English, as the showcase does. Every session that changes the client appends: state for where the tree stands, lesson for a deviation from expectation, open for unfinished work, build when an APK is sealed, handover at the end of a shift with Effectiveness: N/10. python3 verify.py must hold after each append. wall.py is the only writer.

How we continue: the score in docs/parity-1277.md. Done on the everyday path: identity, chats, letters, media, presence, live draft, stickers, share-in, the box every quarter hour. Still open, the large engines: calls (section 7), Montana network as a node (section 13), VPN (section 14), letters while the app is closed beyond the scheduler, groups that leave the device, stories, names, write-by-address. Next work takes one of those engines, not a new screen beside them.

Expected: Montana Android and Montana Android Legacy are two copies of one client. Came out: they are two different clients. Legacy is Gradle plus Jetpack Compose, Java sources, ships prebuilt libmt_bindings.so for three ABIs, applicationId quest.montana.app, minSdk 21, version 0.96.0 (240), talks to montana.quest over OkHttp, has WebRTC calls, a push foreground service, and still exposes nativeEntropyToMnemonic. Current is platform tools only, views written by hand, links the core crates itself as libmontana.so for arm64, minSdk 26, version catching iOS 1277, frozen node-wire formulas in Pipes.kt, invitations and first meeting in Meeting.kt, Google backup of the sealed words, and no door from app entropy to a phrase. Legacy last commit 4d8e44e; current last commit 0acca41. Do not mix their trees.

Master 1 at 02.10.2026 15:26 MSK. The tree is app/src/main Kotlin (48 files, package quest.montana.app), native/montana-jni (libmontana.so from the protocol crates, not mt-bindings), scripts/build.sh (aapt2, kotlinc, d8, no Gradle), scripts/build-core.sh (cargo ndk arm64), docs/parity-1277.md. Git: 65 commits on HEAD, version scripts/version shows 1.0 with TARGET=1277 (own build is the commit count). Install id is quest.montana.app.dev so it sits beside any old Montana on the phone. Head of source: 0acca41.

This is the master's TimeChain of Montana Android, the client in this repository. It has the same shape as the public wall at github.com/efir369999/montana_messenger: one JSON line, SHA-256 of the canonical body, prev the hash of the record before it, newest first. A record's time and master are the writer's word, signed by no key. This chain is not the iOS master's chain; it begins here from sixty-four zeros.
